title: Lady in Red Before the Painting
Sunny Side of the Sky
description: A woman's face is hidden behind three fried eggs, their bright yolks covering her eyes and brow, against a blue sky with soft white clouds.

title: The Camera Bride
description: A dark-haired woman in a black lace gown embraces a hulking vintage camera on a tripod, in a faded sepia photograph.

title: Brass Menagerie
description: Copper boilers, gears and gauges crowd a display hall, a riot of strange brass machines under bright exhibition lights.

title: Tiki After Midnight
description: A grinning man in thick black glasses peers out of violet fog beside a carved tiki pole, lit in electric blue and purple.

title: The Doll-Head Engine
description: Rows of porcelain doll heads are bolted into a towering brass-and-iron machine in a dim industrial workshop.

title: Her Mechanical Suitor
description: A pale goth woman in a red-and-black lace gown holds the hand of a dark, riveted robot, in an aged colour photograph.

title: Woman of Broken Glass
description: A woman's head and shoulders are sheathed in jagged shards of blue glass that fall like hair around her calm face.

title: The Watcher on Lovers' Lane
description: An enormous eye stares out between dark pines above a red car parked in a forest clearing at night.

title: Red Eye Over the Pines
description: A huge red-rimmed eye glows in the misty blue sky over a forest, while an old car waits on the road below with its headlights on.

title: The Lantern Grotto
description: A glowing room overflows with giant neon flowers and mushroom lamps in pink, orange and blue, around an arched window.

title: Sleeping Giantess of the Hills
description: A blonde giantess in a peach dress sleeps on a grassy hillside, with a domed observatory and cypress trees on the hills behind her.

title: New Year's Eve at the Haunted Villa
description: A grand ruined villa with arched loggias rises above stone steps and twisted bare trees, painted in dusky blues and golds.

title: The Lamplight Fairy
description: A 1920s woman wears a pale costume of glowing glass wings and a jewelled headdress strung with tiny lights.

title: Widow in the Garden
description: A woman in a black lace gown and wide-brimmed hat sits among the leaves of an overgrown garden, in an old colour photograph.

title: Twin Moon-Gazers
description: Two women in robes sit on either side of a red balcony, watching a huge golden moon rise over misty mountains and a still lake.

title: Breakfast Panic
description: A wide-eyed woman stares in shock as a crown of fried eggs bursts from her hair, set against a flat desert horizon.

title: Shell of a Face
description: A cracked porcelain mask of a woman's face lies on a sandy shore, one eye replaced by a glossy egg yolk.

title: The Spirit House Mask
description: A tall carved mask with a long nose and patterned face in yellow and black stands in a museum case among carved panels.

title: Glass Cage Portrait
description: A woman's face looks out from a cage of fractured glass panes and wire, cold blue light glinting on every edge.

title: The Crystal Merchant's Hall
description: A long wooden shop is lined with shelves and tables heaped with crystals and minerals, under hanging lamps.

title: A Squall of Eggs
description: A woman crowned with a heap of white eggs gazes calmly as dozens of eggs fly past her in a blue sky.

title: Overeasy Cloudburst
description: A cloud of fried eggs piles over a woman's eyes and hair, leaving only her red lips visible beneath the sunny yolks.

title: Drifting Through the Yolks
description: A woman lies back with eyes closed in calm water, surrounded by floating fried eggs under a blue sky.

title: Golden Star Automaton
description: A golden robot with a blue skeletal face and exposed ribs sits among planets and stars in a comic-book cosmos.

title: The Silver Siren
description: A silver-haired woman in a glittering sculpted bodysuit with curled horn-like ornaments poses against a black background.

title: Prairie Omelette
description: A crown of fried eggs balances on a startled woman's head, her mouth open, above an empty prairie with old wagons on the horizon.

title: Teahouse at Moonrise
description: A woman in a kimono sits on a veranda gazing at a golden moon over a lake, a pavilion and boats reflected on the water.

title: The Eye That Waits
description: A great yellow eye glows above a dark forest pool, with a vintage car parked among the trees beneath it.

title: Lady of the Night Roses
description: A dark-haired woman in black lace sits among deep green leaves and red roses, in a faded vintage photograph.

title: The Mannequin Lights the Jar
description: A mannequin in a gold cap and embroidered dress reaches toward a glass jar, sparks of light floating around her in the dark.

title: Snowman on Patchwork Winter
description: A cheerful snowman in an orange top hat and striped scarf stands before snowy pines in a textured collage of paint and paper.

title: The Clockwork Workshop
description: A crowded workshop is filled with brass machines, gears and contraptions on tables and shelves, in warm amber light.

title: Served on a Blue Plate
description: A woman's face peers from between fried eggs heaped on a white plate, set on a blue cloth against black.

title: The Scarlet Window
description: A mannequin draped head to toe in a red veil and jewelled gown sits in a shop window hung with strands of crystal drops.

title: The Forest Iris
description: A giant eye opens in the trunk of an ancient tree, gazing over a pale car abandoned in a tangled forest.

title: Sky Full of Breakfast
description: A dark-haired woman tilts her face to the sky as fried eggs drift past her like clouds.

title: Pearl-Lit Flapper
description: A woman with marcelled hair wears a pale bodysuit studded with tiny lights and a jewelled headband.

title: Midnight Mineral Shop
description: A vaulted shop in deep blue holds glass cases of crystals and shelves of jars under a hanging golden lantern.

title: Butterfly Summer, 1968
description: A young woman with long auburn hair poses against a weathered wall in a black butterfly-print top and shorts.

title: Ice Queen in Sequins
description: A woman in a spiked silver cap and a bodysuit of icy, glittering shards stands against a dark backdrop with soft lights.

title: The Keeper of Hours
description: A grey-haired old man in round spectacles sits in blue shadow beside a large antique clock face.

title: Fried-Egg Spectacles
description: Two fried eggs cover a woman's eyes like enormous spectacles, against a blue sky and a flat sandy horizon.

title: Twelve Faces Under Glass
description: A dozen worn doll heads fill the panel of a dark iron machine with dials and knobs.

title: The Rust Hunter
description: A rusted biomechanical robot creeps on long jointed limbs through a jungle washed in dripping greens, reds and gold.

title: Wind and Yolks
description: Fried eggs cluster over a woman's eyes and brow while her hair streams sideways against a blue sky.

title: Blue Sweater Afternoon
description: A young woman with long wavy blonde hair sits cross-legged on a bed in a blue sweater and white socks.

title: Constellation Gown
description: A woman with sculpted dark curls wears a pale glowing bodysuit traced with light, a halo of tiny bulbs fanning out behind her head.

title: The Frost Sentinel
description: A woman wears a towering crystalline helmet and a silver armoured gown that glows with cold white light.

title: Halo of Light
description: A blonde woman stands beneath a fan of glowing glass rays, her bodice patterned with whorls of metal and light.

title: The Green Muse
description: A dark-haired woman in a flowing green dress glances over her shoulder against a mottled green wall.

title: Lagoon of the Pale Moon
description: A pale moon glows over a misty lagoon framed by pines and a distant pagoda, in soft greens and gold.

title: Copper Dream Machine
description: A gleaming copper 1940s car sits in a showroom crowded with fantastical brass machines and red carpet.

title: Yolk Storm
description: A woman's eyes vanish under a cluster of fried eggs, the yolks glowing against a deep blue sky.

title: Two Eggs, One Stare
description: A giant cracked face stares out from behind two fried eggs, with more eggs laid on a table before it.

title: The Chrome Conservatory
description: A sleek bronze 1950s car is displayed among tropical plants and red foliage in a glass-roofed hall.

title: Electric Peacock
description: A woman in a towering crown of blue and silver spikes poses in a shimmering gown before rows of glowing lights.

title: The Horseless Carousel
description: An antique open carriage stands in a grand dining room hung with chandeliers, in black and white.

title: The Black Gown on the Stairs
description: A pale woman in a black gown stands on mossy stone steps strewn with autumn leaves beside a crumbling wall.

title: Prayer of the Golden Mannequin
description: A mannequin with a pale face and gold filigree headdress presses her hands together in prayer, in a dark room with glowing lamps.

title: Eggs at Eye Level
description: Two fried eggs sit over a woman's eyes, three more lined up on the table below her face, against a dark backdrop.

title: Cobalt Showgirl
description: A woman in a sparkling blue headdress and a bodysuit of silver piping and lights stands in a beam of cool light.

title: The Moss Walker
description: A hunched green biomechanical robot, its body overgrown with moss and wires, walks through a rainy forest.

title: Stilt Machine of the Old Quarter
description: A tall walking machine on spindly legs wades through flooded streets past old stone buildings and a cathedral.

title: Unlaced in Jade
description: A dark-haired woman in a pale green gown looks back over her bare shoulder, against a mottled green wall.

title: The Fortune Box
description: A glowing arcade cabinet in a red-lit booth shows a grim face behind its glass window, crowned with a row of lights.

title: The Iris in the Trees
description: A vast golden eye fills the sky over a forest road, where a pale vintage car is parked among the trees.

title: Marcel Wave in Starlight
description: A woman with glossy marcelled hair poses in a striped, beaded black gown strung with tiny lights.

title: Spiked Crystal Debutante
description: A blonde woman wears a tiara of crystal spikes and a gown of glass shards that sparkle against the dark.

title: The Lightbulb Rock Shop
description: Bare bulbs hang over a wooden shop full of shelves and cabinets of rocks and minerals, sunlight falling through tall windows.

title: The Woman by the Etched Door
description: A woman in a long dress sits beside an ornate etched door with a keypad, drawn in teal and black like a mezzotint.

title: Peepholes
description: A stern woman and a bald man peer out through two narrow openings in a dark carved wooden door.

title: The Doll Carousel
description: Dozens of bald doll heads are mounted on the poles of a rusted white carousel machine, against a pale grey backdrop.

title: Lantern Hour at the Old House
description: Figures gather in glowing arched doorways of an old stone house at night, beneath a twisted tree.

title: Full Moon on the Floating Pavilion
description: A full moon hangs over misty blue mountains as a glowing pavilion is reflected in a calm lake.

title: The Crystal Holder
description: A bald man in a black robe holds a clear crystal ball before ornate dark wooden panels.

title: Last Ride at the Dead Fair
description: An abandoned carousel sits in a ruined, graffiti-covered hall with puddles on the cracked floor.

title: Neon Starlet
description: A blonde woman with a 1930s wave wears a silver striped gown traced with light, against neon city glow.

title: Golden Hair, Painted Wings
description: A woman with long golden hair poses in a black dress covered in bright butterflies.

title: Sunflower Eye
description: A glowing amber eye opens in a dark forest, above a rusted car parked in red underbrush.

title: The Star Crown
description: A woman wears a towering crown of glowing glass rays and a jewelled bodice, lit in cool blue.

title: A Glass of Water, Alone
description: A man in a hat sits in shadow at a bare table with a single glass of water, in black and white.

title: Moon Jellyfish Couture
description: A woman in a pale blue helmet trailing fine wires wears a gown dotted with soft round lights.

title: Golden Hour Girl, 1968
description: A young woman with long hair in a black top and butterfly skirt looks back over her shoulder in warm light.

title: Lace and Tapestry
description: A young woman with wavy blonde hair in a blue lace top and denim shorts sits against a rich tapestry wall.

title: The Spun-Glass Gown
description: A woman in a jewelled headdress wears a gown of translucent glass fins lit from within, against blue.

title: The Owl-Eyed Mask
description: A round-eyed carved mask painted in yellow, red and black stands in a dark museum gallery of carvings.

title: Who's at the Door
description: A pale man in a top hat peers out from behind a weathered wooden door into the dark.

title: The Feathered Guardian
description: A carved mask with a crest of wooden plumes and painted eyes stands in a museum case among carved panels.

title: The Bride in Lace and Beads
description: A mannequin in a lace veil and heavy beaded necklaces sits before red drapes in a shop window.

title: Mirror-Shard Head
description: A man's head is built from cracked panes of blue-grey mirror, against a plain pale background.

title: Hot Bath of the Morning
description: A woman lies back in water with eyes closed, half-cooked eggs floating around her and a cloud of egg white over her head.

title: The Ringed Ancestor
description: A carved bronze-brown mask with large round ear ornaments stands between walls of carved panels.

title: Four Eggs Sunny
description: Four fried eggs line up across a woman's eyes as her tousled hair spills out beneath them, against a blue sky.

title: Beatnik Under the Parasol
description: A woman in black with sunglasses lounges in a deck chair under an orange parasol, sipping a drink, in a flat illustrated style.

title: Sea Wind
description: A dark-haired woman in a ruffled black-and-white gown stands by the sea, her hair blown by the wind, in black and white.

title: The Chrome Debutante
description: A woman with a curled wire headpiece wears a sculpted silver bodysuit dotted with lights, in a dark room.

title: The Brass Bazaar
description: Dozens of brass machines, domes and contraptions crowd a dim exhibition hall under strings of lights.

title: Laughing Totem
description: A tall carved wooden mask with a wide grin and patterned brow stands in a gallery of carved panels.

title: Silver Helm
description: A woman in an ornate silver helmet with glowing round lamps wears gleaming metal armour.

title: The Winged Mask
description: A carved mask with wide wooden wings and a calm, closed-eyed face stands in a pale gallery.

title: Starlit Torso
description: A woman with short dark waves and a crown of lights wears a ribbed metallic bodysuit glowing with stars.

title: Mask of Many Colours
description: A carved mask painted in red, yellow, black and white zigzags stands in a dark museum case.

title: Eyes Over Easy
description: Two fried eggs cover a woman's eyes, their whites spreading into clouds against a blue sky.

title: Ruby Fin
description: A gleaming red 1950s car with tall chrome fins is displayed under glittering lights in a dark showroom.

title: Amethyst Emporium
description: A narrow shop overflows with crystals and amethyst in lit glass cabinets and baskets, under hanging lamps.

title: Lantern Armour
description: A woman with 1930s waves wears a sculpted metallic suit fitted with round glowing lamps and a curved antenna.

title: Ember Sunset on the Lake
description: A blazing orange sun sets over a calm lake, lighting the water red beside a dark wooden house and pines.

title: Veiled in Scarlet
description: A mannequin in a red veil and beaded red gown sits behind sheer drapes in a teal-lit window.

title: The Weary Astronaut
description: A spacesuited astronaut sits slumped on a rocky alien hillside, with a ringed planet and a starry sky behind.

title: The Morning Halo
description: A woman's eyes peer out from a ring of fried eggs and cracked shell that circles her head, against a blue sky.
